summary: The agents roster's burst-of-local-commits test no longer counts how many claims its writer thread made. It checks that the writer was alive by asserting that the writer's last write landed after the last pause began. The count, more than 20 in about a second, failed every try when the build host was saturated and each write took over 55 ms. The new check fails only if the writer stopped, however slowly each write goes.

replay.detail: Test only; nothing in the daemon changes.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, registry or coordinated member upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: No API, CLI or wire change.
